description: This file defines the `ValidationResult` class, which models the outcome of migration validation checks in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for constructing validation results, converting them to strings, and querying their validity and issues.

classes.name: ValidationResult
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the result of migration validation, including a list of issues and methods to interpret and display validation status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ValidationResult with an optional array of issues.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representing the validation result, listing issues if any, or confirming success.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Returns true if there are no issues, indicating validation passed.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Returns the list of issues recorded in the validation result.
